description: Applies the governing ad valorem rate for an HTS code to a customs value and returns the indicative duty, with the free-trade rate shown separately when the origin qualifies. It states plainly what is excluded rather than presenting a total that looks complete. Use it for a directional landed-cost figure, never as a customs declaration.

customs_value_usd.description: Declared customs value in USD. For most imports this is the transaction value of the goods, excluding international freight and insurance.

origin_country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country of origin of the goods, for example CN or AU.

name: estimate_us_duty
title: Estimate the US duty payable on a shipment
